images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole solar plant visible inside the frame.
images.detail: Concentric rings of tilted polished mirrors surround the tower and all face toward its top.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff, open to the sky, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.
images.subject: A solar power plant built around one colossal central tower with a brilliantly glowing receiver at its top. In the bottom right corner of the frame, on the plateau outside the mirror field, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a massive high-voltage electrical substation with giant transformers and crackling blue-white electric arcs, from which a line of colossal steel transmission pylons runs away across the plateau. In the bottom of the frame, in the foreground and larger than the substation, a third massive and clearly separate block: a huge turbine hall, a long multi-level power generation building with rows of giant generator housings glowing with blue-white light, linked to the substation by thick cables.
